title: dev.qory.run.target_write
description: One state of one write the run sent through the proxy to a place in another system: started when the write begins, then one of changed, refused or cut when it ends. The gateway writes it, for a request the proxy reads: a request inside a connection the proxy terminates, or a plain request. One kind of request counts as a write, a git push over HTTP: a POST whose path ends in /git-receive-pack. Every write with a started has its end before dev.qory.run.exited, unless the gateway stops while the write is open; a receiver reads a started with no end in a run that ended as cut.

system.description: The system the write went to: the request's host, as the host of the request's dev.qory.run.egress, a lower-case name or an IP literal in canonical form, without the port. For a git push it is the forge label qory gives a run whose origin remote is on that host. A value that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_, qeci_ or qecd_ in any case is a phrase in its place, as in dev.qory.run.egress.

path.description: The place in the system the write went to. For a git push, the request's path, decoded, or as sent when it has an encoded slash, backslash, dot or percent sign, a backslash, an empty segment or a dot segment, without /git-receive-pack at its end, without its leading and trailing slash and without a .git at its end: the repository label qory gives a run whose origin remote has that path, such as example-org/app for /example-org/app.git/git-receive-pack. A value that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_, qeci_ or qecd_ in any case is a phrase in its place, as in dev.qory.run.egress.

state.description: started: the write began, the request went to the system. changed: the system reported the write done, in part or whole: for a git push, unpack ok and at least one ref ok, so a push with some refs ok and some ng is changed. refused: the system reported the write not done: for a git push, a 4xx status, an unpack error, or every ref ng. cut: the write ended without a report the gateway could read, such as when the transport failed, the status was 5xx, the answer was a fatal error or could not be read, or the run ended during the write; the system may have applied it.

request_id.description: The proxy's id of the request: the request_id of the request's dev.qory.run.egress. The same on the write's started and on its end.
